title: Context Artifact Priority Preservation
objective: Preserve authoritative context relevance priority through bounded artifact loading so higher-priority selected context cannot be displaced by lower-priority paths solely because of alphabetical reordering.
architecturalContext: Repository context selection already produces deterministic relevance-ranked RiverDevContextRelevantEntry records.
loadContextArtifacts currently re-sorts those ranked entries alphabetically before applying its bounded total-byte budget.

The alphabetical re-sort can omit approved-scope artifacts while lower-priority context consumes the byte budget, causing downstream architecture-grounded understanding to lose authoritative selected context.

The repair must preserve deterministic behavior, existing byte limits, protected-path blocking, per-artifact truncation, and bundle accounting while retaining caller-provided deterministic relevance order.
acceptanceCriteria: loadContextArtifacts preserves the deterministic caller-provided relevance order when applying the bounded total-byte loading budget.
Higher-priority entries supplied earlier by authoritative context selection are not displaced solely by alphabetical path ordering.
Existing maximum per-artifact and total-byte limits remain unchanged.
Bundle loadedBytes, loadedCount, truncatedCount, omittedCount, and artifact metadata remain correct.
Regression tests prove priority preservation under a byte budget with deliberately reverse-alphabetical high-priority input.
No context-selection ranking, planning governance, architecture analysis, repository discovery, execution, authorization, or network behavior is broadened or rewritten.
requiredTests: UNDERSTAND-003 context artifact loader priority-preservation tests
Existing context artifact loader regression tests
Complete River Development Agent regression suite
approvalBoundaries: Do not modify context selection ranking.
Do not change artifact byte-budget constants.
Do not modify PLAN-001 checkpoint state.
Stop if the repair requires changing context-engine, context-understanding, repository discovery, planning, execution, authorization, or architecture-map boundaries.
commitMessage: UNDERSTAND-003: Preserve context artifact relevance priority
